phase: BEFORE baseline, independent basic-only human reading under unchanged pre-output criteria

input.scope: Only cases id/current_fen/focus/verdict/text/default_question from the basic export were read. The source hash is exported metadata, not hidden evidence for a missing explanation.

criteria.literal: Use the unchanged pre-output source criteria: recover the current task, actual chosen move function/judgment, adequate consequential counter and required price; distinguish local legal/price facts from full usefulness and original numerical cause. Alternative realizations are accepted; a book PV match is neither necessary nor sufficient. Record unnecessary detail, omissions and explicit unsupported claims separately.

input_match: All eight visible root FENs and played UCIs exactly match the presealed engine-neutral controls.
old_four_full_utility: Unchanged 0/4. This is a distinct eight-input exposed development baseline, not a rescore of NC4/NB1/A5/EXF5.
counting_rule: Omission/excess units count named topic groups per answer, not unique global mechanisms or chess errors. Missing causal explanation is not counted as an explicit unsupported causal claim. Numerical labels/deltas are transcribed observations, not verified or treated as reasons. Partial status allows substantial bounded facts; 0 complete answers does not mean 0 correct facts.
firstpass_conclusion: All eight answers retain some useful facts, but no answer completes its frozen minimum human task. The central recurring gap is organization of those facts into purpose, premature commitment, adequate current defense and relevant cost. Explicit universal/root-numeric causal overclaim was not observed; one visible alternative-line price summary is internally unclear/conflicting.

recoverable.actual_move: The same knight moves g8–f6; the g8 position temporarily loses d5 support and f6 restores it.
recoverable.consequential_reply: Rf1 attacks Bf2 and Bh4 is an evasion. Other Qe2/Bxg1 and Kh7/Bxe3 events are reported.
recoverable.important_price: The Bxg1/Kxg1 bishop-for-knight exchange is locally readable. The alternative Kh7 ending is described through several disconnected captures, with a conflicting summary.

needed_judgment_missing: Why the e7 knight needs improvement and what e4/g4 options the maneuver preserves.
A clear basic purpose tying the restored d5 support to continuing activity, rather than presenting loss/restoration of support as competing isolated facts.
No causal explanation of the numerical best-choice margin is established; this is not required for a purpose-only success, but must not be inferred from the list.
cases.adequate_defense_status: No organized current defense against the actual improvement is explained. Rf1/Bh4 is readable as a local attack/evasion, not a strongest-response survey.
cases.alternative_good_plan_status: Kh7 is named as a comparator but not explained as a viable different improvement or evaluated independently in human terms.

unclear_or_conflicting_price_claims.text: In the Kh7 line, White gives up one knight for one bishop and one queen.
unclear_or_conflicting_price_claims.issue: The same paragraph says Rxe6 recaptures the white queen and Rxe2 captures the white knight, while Qxe3 takes the black bishop. The natural reading of “gives up one knight for ... one queen” conflicts with White’s queen being captured. Hidden line/proof was not inspected, so this is an internal prose/accounting warning, not a claim about the true final material.

misleading_implications: The opening lists two support losses without stating the positive improvement, making the preferred quiet move sound like unexplained weakening.
same_input_after_requirements: Retain the currently recoverable Nf6/d5 support fact.
Make the maneuver’s purpose and useful future options recoverable without demanding the exact later author line.
Keep any selected essential price intelligible and avoid the internally conflicting Kh7 summary.

The early ...Rxb6 recapture can be met by White Rb1xb6, with the Nd6 blocker preventing a cheap queen recapture; this is the sealed local price control, not a newly required global proof.
Why preserving the powerful c4 knight and b6 matters to the original practical decision; White’s more useful extra a-pawn is not mentioned.

cases.alternative_good_plan_status: Ng8 is named but its useful knight improvement is not connected to the actual decision.

limitations: This is natural-language recovery, not engine-score accuracy validation.

Exact immediate price is not a full original numerical cause or all-defense utility proof.
